description: The suppletive adjectival triples of Table 4.1 and quantifier triples of Table 4.2, with the Karelian triple of (170): positive, comparative and superlative forms as printed, each triple with the root classes Bobaljik assigns its grades. A triple counts once however many languages share it (section 1.3). Table 4.2 prints 38 triples; the text gives 39 (pp. 124, 126).

forms.comment: none of the seven respondents to the 2009 questionnaire gave äijin as the superlative of 'many' or recognized it when asked; four gave enin
